description: This file defines the 'Wrapped' class which provides methods to gather various statistics (notes, organization, attachments) from the Notesnook database, including functions for calculating word counts, note stats, and related data.

classes.name: Wrapped
classes.description: A class that provides methods to compute and retrieve various statistics related to notes, organization, and attachments within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Main method to retrieve combined statistics for the current year.

methods.name: getYearRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end timestamps for the current year.

methods.name: getNoteStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to notes within a specified date range.

methods.name: countItemNotes
methods.description: Counts the number of notes associated with given tags or notebooks.

methods.name: getOrganizationStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to notebooks, tags, and colors within a date range.

methods.name: getAttachmentStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to attachments within a date range.

methods.name: countTotalWords
methods.description: Counts total words across notes and identifies the largest note.
